method: Human-authorized fifth verification round (Jaden, 2026-10-10: 'run a fresh independent verifier round for the behavior research stages'). New integer seed drawn once with secrets.randbits(63) before the sample was computed. One fresh-context reviewer agent per sampled entry read only the entry gapfill, its generated record, FETCH_LEDGER.jsonl (URL-to-SHA256 mapping only) and the archived primary-source bytes, using PyMuPDF/pdftotext extraction and rendered pages; no web access, no other repository files, no prior verifier reports. operating_ambient_range = [-40, 85] C, p.4: OK. 6.3 ROC TA, SN74HC595 column: MIN -40, MAX 85 degC. The SN54HC595 column (-55..125) was correctly not used. The p.17 addendum gives Op temp -40 to 85 for every SN74HC595D* orderable.

thermal_resistance_junction_ambient = 73 K/W, p.5: OK. 6.4 Thermal Information, SN74HC595 D (SOIC) 16 pins: RthetaJA = 73 degC/W. The table gives no board condition beyond a reference to SPRA953, so the record's 'TI thermal reference condition' scope is generic but not contradicted. For a thermal resistance, K/W equals degC/W.

input_capacitance_typical = 3 pF, p.5: OK. 6.5 Electrical Characteristics: Ci at VCC 2 V to 6 V, TA = 25 degC TYP 3 pF. MAX is 10 pF at 25 degC, and the SN74HC595 MAX over temperature is 10 pF. The record scope correctly limits the value to the 25 degC typical column.

off_state_output_leakage_max = 5 uA, p.5: OK. 6.5 EC IOZ: VO = VCC or 0, QA-QH, VCC = 6 V, SN74HC595 MAX +/-5 uA. The SN54HC595 value (+/-10 uA) and the 25 degC MAX (+/-0.5 uA) were correctly not used.
